# Waqas Aziz | Logo and Brand Identity Designer

> Strategic logo design and brand identity for startups and growing businesses. Logos with purpose, identities that last. Based in Lahore, Pakistan, working worldwide.

## About

- [About Waqas Aziz](https://designbywaqasaziz.github.io/about.html): Designer first, strategist always. Logo and brand identity designer for startups and growing businesses. Also builds practical digital products for other designers from his own workflow.

## Services

- [Services](https://designbywaqasaziz.github.io/services.html): Logo Design, Complete Brand Identity, Brand Guidelines, and Brand Applications.
- [Logo Design](https://designbywaqasaziz.github.io/services.html#logo-design): A simple, distinctive, flexible mark that works everywhere, from a favicon to a storefront.
- [Complete Brand Identity](https://designbywaqasaziz.github.io/services.html#brand-identity): The full visual system around your mark, so every touchpoint looks and feels like one company.
- [Brand Guidelines](https://designbywaqasaziz.github.io/services.html#brand-guidelines): A rulebook that protects your brand from inconsistent use across designers, printers, and platforms.
- [Brand Applications](https://designbywaqasaziz.github.io/services.html#brand-applications): Your identity rolled out across packaging, social templates, marketing pieces, and decks.

## Process

How it works, from first message to final files: 1. Brief. You describe your business, audience, and goals in a short project brief. 2. Concepts. The strongest logo concepts are presented with reasoning. 3. Refinement. The chosen direction is refined together through the agreed revision rounds. 4. Delivery. You receive the complete file package with usage notes. Full ownership transfers on final payment.

## Start a project

- [Start a Project](https://designbywaqasaziz.github.io/start-project.html): Send a brief and get a tailored quote.
- [Client Brief Form](https://designbywaqasaziz.github.io/client-brief.html): The full brief form, covering business details, service type, audience, style, colors, references, logo usage, deadline, budget, and contact.

## FAQ

- [FAQ](https://designbywaqasaziz.github.io/faq.html): Answers about services, pricing, timelines, files, revisions, ownership, digital products, and refunds. Every project is quoted individually after a short brief. There are no fixed prices. Final files include vector sources in AI, EPS, and SVG, plus PNG and JPG exports. Full ownership of the final logo transfers on final payment.
